spell_materials.description: Saved material supplies associated with exact carried inventory entries. quantity counts material units and value_cp is each unit value in copper. components names exact spell component IDs (for example stoneskin.1). Declare only established supplies; casting consumes them. A focus or pouch still needs a carried item. Zero quantity retains the supply identity.

worn_armor.description: The actual worn carried item, or null when this slot is empty.

worn_shield.description: The actual worn carried item, or null when this slot is empty.

initial_state_validation.description:
Supply complete spellcasting_grants for actual classes, feats and lineage, including automatic spells. Use each source's ability, spell list and own class level. Save Wizard spellbook entries and required subclasses; prepared_spells must equal the grant union. The draft checker returns missing or invalid choices before publication. Preserve validated starting equipment, Fighting Styles, Focus and Wholeness of Body.
Selected repertoire capacity only, not character acceptance. Counts are available/required; policy means a rule-dependent requirement. Keep complete distinct legal grants, subclasses and earned progression. Add implemented profiles for shortfalls; never duplicate choices or use pending spells. Gameplay verification remains pending.
